name: PNC Cash Rewards Visa Signature Business Credit Card

localized_names.en: PNC Cash Rewards Visa Signature Business Credit Card

apr.notes: Introductory 0% APR for the first 9 billing cycles following account opening on purchases. Then a variable APR, currently 17.49% to 27.74%, based on creditworthiness. This APR will vary with the market based on the prime rate.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee not stated on product page.

base_rate.description: Earn unlimited 1.5% cash back on all net purchases. No category restrictions and no caps on the cash back you can earn.

rewards.redemption_notes: No category restrictions and no caps on the cash back you can earn.

signup_bonus.description: Earn a $400 Statement Credit after making at least $3,000 in net purchases during the first three billing cycles following account opening.

benefits.title: Zero Liability Fraud Protection
benefits.description: If your Visa Business card is ever lost or stolen, your company is protected against fraudulent use of the card, including transactions made via telephone or on the internet.

benefits.title: Extended Protection (Warranty)
benefits.description: Doubles the time period of the original manufacturer's written U.S. warranty up to one (1) full year on warranties of three years or less.

benefits.title: Purchase Security
benefits.description: Will replace, repair, or reimburse you for eligible items of personal property in the event of theft or damage within the first 90 days of purchase.

notes: Verified from official product page. Annual fee not stated on page text (rates PDF not accessible). Page title references 'PNC Business Cash Rewards' but legal disclosure confirms 'PNC Cash Rewards Visa Signature Business Credit Card'.
